integrity: The equilibrium equations and Jacobian spectra were reconstructed directly from the displayed vector field. The accepted stability statements use exact characteristic polynomials and exact Routh-sign analysis; numerical values are illustrative only.
scientific_limitations: The result proves only a spectral Hopf crossing at the negative equilibrium branch; it does not establish a nonlinear Hopf bifurcation or periodic-orbit branch.
It does not prove existence, uniqueness, or basin geometry of any chaotic or hyperchaotic attractor.
The literature comparison is targeted rather than exhaustive, so an unindexed independent correction remains possible.
title: Two missed equilibria and an exact stability threshold in the Fu–Cheng–Liu hyperchaotic flow
